captions.detailed: A rugged mountain bike dropper post featuring a dark textured outer body and a telescoping silver inner shaft. The post is topped with a black contoured trail saddle mounted on silver rails, which are secured to a machined alloy clamp head. A thin black control cable port extends downward from the collar assembly, and the inner shaft moves linearly along the vertical axis via a prismatic joint.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated mountain bike dropper post with a telescoping inner shaft and a mounted saddle. The outer body should be black, the telescoping shaft should be silver, and the saddle assembly should include mounting rails and a control cable, configured with a prismatic joint to allow vertical travel.
captions.factory: Construct the dropper post by creating an ArticulatedObject. Model the outer body as a fixed base Part containing a black cylinder. Define a telescoping inner shaft Part using a silver cylinder, and connect it to the base using a prismatic joint along the Z-axis. Attach the saddle assembly—consisting of a contoured seat, mounting rails, and a cable port—to the top of the telescoping shaft Part.
